scope: Offline gradients and optimizer-aware virtual partial updates on192 existing snapshots. No environment rollouts or persistent learner update. Protocol written before F04 results, historical outcomes already seen.
panels: Same episode-disjoint M/A sampling scheme as F05. Eight batches128/task/panel, each containing16 samples from each of8 age strata. M/A are old replay, not unseen environment data. Local RNG, original state and files verified unchanged.
gradients: Actor gradient of mean(alpha logpi-minQ); critic gradient of0.5*(MSE Q1+MSE Q2), stored target networks, current detached alpha, one stochastic target action per transition, timeout bootstrap matches SAC. Frozen-network partial gradients; actor is NOT recomputed after a virtual critic update. No entropy or target-network update.
exposure: At20k use sampled task count increments relative to its parent snapshot; at parent use current replay task fractions. Never use20to40k realized exposure. Compare equal task weights and observed exposure weights at the SAME snapshot.
adam: For each batch and module, clone parameter tensors and exact Adam state then make one virtual optimizer step. Weighted M gradients used; separate A gradients score first-order change. Reciprocal A->M is audit. Both exposure and uniform weights. Parameters/state reset before every virtual step. No original optimizer step.
normalization: -g_eval dot delta / max(RMS per-transition evaluation loss,1e-6), average equally over4 tasks then8 batches. Actor RMS uses signed per-sample SAC loss squared; critic per-sample loss is mean twin squared residual. These are local surrogate loss predictions, NOT success or true value gradients.
secondary_features: Two off-diagonal mean raw cosines(actor/critic); two exposure-weighted raw descent alignments using eval-panel gradients; two uniform-weight Adam loss-descent features; reciprocal audit features. Norm ratios, negative-pair fraction, batch signs, step norms, alpha/entropy reported descriptively, not additional searched features.
base: F01 full task marginal profile (focus/cp400,4p0,4delta,4positive declines), plus F05 log1p reward RMS,target RMS,normalized residual,normalized gap. Also show Profile and Profile_F04 to distinguish F05 conditioning. Do not condition on F01 turnover.
prediction: SAME-branch D40-D20 target. F07 hash split D50/O50. Weighted ridge penalty1 in mean loss, fold-only standardization, unpenalized intercept. Leave original seed out across all suites/checkpoints. No tuning or task/seed labels. Same-repeat primary, cross-repeat secondary. Uniform/Failure/Greedy20/Development_fixed controls, ties1e-12.
screen: Exploratory triage primary increment>=1pp, >=2 positive original seed blocks, no group below-2pp; examine panel/batch reliability and strong controls. No causal attribution from cosine and no independent confirmation.
costs: Record new environment and persistent learner updates0, virtual optimizer steps separately, CUDA and wall/CPU time. Historical probes100k plus continuation20k primary,200k plus independent40k secondary, plus parent/probe evaluation. No cost-inclusive40k online claim.
verification: Reconstruct all features from per-batch gradient Gram matrices/dot products; independent augmented-LS and selection reconstruction. Re-run fixed representative gradients/checkpoints, finite differences with fixed noise, verify clone Adam against independent formula and hashes. Preserve all failures.
